ns2:course.label: Computer Architecture
ns2:course.description: Fundamentals of computer architecture: digital logic design, working up from the logic gate level to understand the function of a simple computer; machine-level programming to understand implementation of high-level languages; performance models of modern computer architectures to enable performance optimization of software; hardware primitives for parallelism and security. Prerequisite: CS 125 and CS 173; credit or concurrent enrollment in CS 225.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: CS 125 and CS 173; credit or concurrent enrollment in CS 225.
